definitions.explanation: A tree that is notably large in size.

examples.japanese: {神社|じんじゃ}に{大木|たいぼく}がある。
examples.english: There is a large tree at the shrine.

examples.japanese: {樹齢|じゅれい}{百年|ひゃくねん}の{大木|たいぼく}が{立|た}っている。
examples.english: A hundred-year-old large tree stands there.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}で{大木|たいぼく}が{倒|たお}れた。
examples.english: A large tree fell in the typhoon.

notes:
{大木|たいぼく} refers to trees that are notably large.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {大木|たいぼく}が{立|た}つ: a large tree stands
- {大木|たいぼく}を{切|き}る: to cut down a large tree
- {古|ふる}い{大木|たいぼく}: an ancient large tree

RELATED WORDS:
- {巨木|きょぼく}: giant tree
- {老木|ろうぼく}: old tree
- {木|き}/{樹木|じゅもく}: tree

[Register: Neutral to slightly formal]
